messages.subject: Groupwise weighted mean?
parts:
Hi

I have a hopefully simple question :-) I want to do groupwise weighted
means. The problem is that I guess ddply() takes the weight variable
among the whole data.frame, not among groups... how can I specify
this?

DF<-data.frame(a=rnorm(5), b=rnorm(5),size=rnorm(5, mean=200, sd=40),
group=sample(letters[1:2], 5, replace=TRUE))

means<-ddply(DF, .(group), numcolwise(mean), na.rm = T)
w.means<-ddply(DF, .(group), numcolwise(weighted.mean), na.rm = T, w=.
(size))

How do I tell ddpla .(size) has to be taken among grops?

Thanks!

Matthieu

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Groupwise weighted mean?
parts:
You need to be a little more verbose so you can be more explicit about
where size comes from:

w.means<-ddply(DF, .(group), function(df) {
numcolwise(weighted.mean)(df, na.rm = T, w=df$size)
})

Hadley
